howto: Press Play. Tap a card to flip it.
Tap a second card to find its twin.
Match all pairs in few tries for 3 stars.
tips: Every third match in a row earns a peek.
The magnifier shows a twin you have already seen.
Find every animal to fill your album.
Win stars to unlock new card backs.

controls.keyboard: Tab or the arrow keys pick a card, Enter or Space flips it. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a card to flip it. Hint and Peek sit at the top.

difficulty: 15 levels in five worlds (farm, ocean, jungle, sweets, space): from 2 up to 10 pairs, with a shorter look at the cards each time.

cheats.effect: Auto pair: one pair matches itself (enter it again for more)
Slow flip: a wrong pair stays face up for 3 seconds

features.hints: The magnifier (and Pause > Hint) makes a twin you have already seen glow; an idle hint appears after 12 seconds
features.undo: Not offered: peeks and hints help instead
features.level-select-or-daily: Level map with stars, plus a daily goal of 3 wins
features.results: Stars card with tries, new album friends and prizes
